name: second-brain
description: Vault-path-agnostic Obsidian second-brain skills (capture, query, config). Vault path resolves from SECOND_BRAIN_VAULT_PATH env var or secondBrain.vaultPath in ~/.claude/settings.json. The config primitive reads and merges YAML frontmatter from vault config files for other skills, degrading gracefully when Obsidian MCP is disconnected.
